title: Why the next phase of India’s AI growth will depend on cloud native skills
description: For India, the opportunity is not simply to adopt AI. It is to help define how AI infrastructure evolves globally. That requires investment in the people who build, operate, and improve the platforms underneath it, because the next phase of AI will not be defined only by who has access to the best models, notes Jonathan Bryce, Executive Director, CNCF.
